<meta>This page is from the Beijing Kanjur, specifically the Collection of Various Sutras. It consists of a repetitive liturgical or invocational structure focusing on the path and physical manifestation of a Bodhisattva.</meta>

The path of the <term>Bodhisattva</term> <gloss>an enlightened being who seeks to aid others</gloss>, and the path of seeking supreme peace.
His body was shown as a <term>parata</term> <gloss>a transliterated term likely referring to a specific manifestation or stage</gloss>.
The path of the Bodhisattva, and the path of the bright light of the Bodhisattva.
The path of peaceful joy, and the path that was shown.
The path of the hero Bodhisattva, and the path of the Bodhisattva.
The path of the <term>parata</term> hero, and the body of the Bodhisattva.
The body of the Bodhisattva, and the body of the Bodhisattva.
The body of the Bodhisattva, and the path that was shown.
The path that was shown, and the body of the Bodhisattva.
The body of the Bodhisattva, and the path that was shown.
The body of the Bodhisattva, and the body of the Bodhisattva.
